label: Half Yoke
description: A half or split yoke is divided by a center seam into two pieces, allowing each half to be cut on an angle and the pattern mirrored or matched at the join. It is considered the more refined, bespoke construction because it enables stripe and check matching across the back and finer fit adjustment at the shoulders. On patterned cloth it creates a striking chevron or mirrored effect down the center back.
